name: What is the average rental income for a tiny home in the San Diego area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average rental income for a tiny home in the San Diego area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Average rental income for a tiny home in the San Diego area can vary widely based on location, amenities, size, and market demand. In areas like Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, and San Marcos, a well-appointed tiny home (ADU) can command rental rates comparable to small apartments or studios, potentially ranging from $1,200 to $2,500+ per month for long-term rentals. Short-term rental income, while often higher per night, is less consistent and subject to additional regulations. Researching local comparables is key to setting appropriate rates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rental income in San Diego varies by location and features, but can range from $1,200 to $2,500+ monthly for long-term tenants in our service areas.
